sqlConfig.query: SELECT DISTINCT project_name::text AS label, project_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT x.*,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-apply_time))/86400 AS pending_days FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) x WHERE NOT is_finished) options WHERE project_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

SELECT DISTINCT status_name::text AS label, status_name::text AS value FROM (SELECT x.*,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-apply_time))/86400 AS pending_days FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) x WHERE NOT is_finished) options WHERE status_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY label

WITH b AS (SELECT x.*,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-apply_time))/86400 AS pending_days FROM (SELECT o.*,c.customer_name,CASE o.order_type WHEN 1 THEN '换花' WHEN 2 THEN '加花' WHEN 3 THEN '减花' WHEN 4 THEN '调花' WHEN 6 THEN '坏账' WHEN 7 THEN '售花' WHEN 8 THEN '赠花' WHEN 10 THEN '辅料' WHEN 11 THEN '加盆架' WHEN 12 THEN '减盆架' ELSE '未知' END AS type_name,CASE o.order_status WHEN -1 THEN '已作废' WHEN 1 THEN '审核中' WHEN 2 THEN '备货中' WHEN 3 THEN '核算中' WHEN 4 THEN '待结算' WHEN 5 THEN '已结束' WHEN 20 THEN '草稿' WHEN 21 THEN '驳回' ELSE '未知' END AS status_name FROM public.prs_v2_dwd_flower_order o LEFT JOIN public.prs_v2_dwd_customer c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id AND c.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.tenant_id WHERE o.is_effective) x WHERE NOT is_finished) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "在途单数", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pending_days>7) AS "挂起超7天", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status=4) AS "待结算", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status=1) AS "审核中", ROUND(AVG(pending_days) FILTER (WHERE pending_days>=0)::numeric,1) AS "平均挂起天数", ROUND(SUM(rent_change_amount)::numeric,2) AS "在途租金变动额" FROM b WHERE business_time >= {{dateFrom}}::date AND business_time < ({{dateTo}}::date + INTERVAL '1 day') [[AND project_name = {{projectName}}]] [[AND status_name = {{statusName}}]]
